notes.title: Major Update!
notes.notes:
Major Update!
Several game enhancements have been made:
1. Added a new gameplay mode and multiple levels.
2. Introduced a toggle switch for puzzle mode that displays puzzle board outlines. Enabling this option significantly reduces puzzle difficulty.
3. The hint feature can now be individually toggled.
4. Interact with cats on the cover and after completing levels.
5. Improved the game interface.
6. Fixed various issues.

notes.title: Game Update Plan
notes.notes:
Based on feedback, we plan to update our game as follows:

1. Add outlines to the base of each level's puzzle to reduce difficulty, with an option to turn the outlines on or off.
2. Introduce a toggle for the hint feature, allowing players to choose whether to enable or disable it.
3. Add new puzzle gameplay and levels.
4. Introduce new puzzle patterns and levels.

These updates are in progress and are expected to be released in the middle to late this month. Stay tuned for updates.
